BriefDescription: Counts cycles in which a valid request to L2 is blocked waiting for a response
Counts AcquireBlock requests to L2 that grow permission from Invalid to Shared or Exclusive
Counts AcquireBlock requests to L2 that grow permission from Shared to Exclusive
Counts AcquirePerm requests to L2 that grow permission
Counts Get requests to L2 for reading data
Counts PutFullData requests to L2 for writing data
Counts PutPartialData requests to L2 for writing data
Counts ArithmeticData and LogicalData requests to L2 for atomic read-modify-write
Counts Intent (Hint) requests to L2 to signal future intention to access data
Counts cycles in which a Probe request from L2 is blocked
Counts cycles in which a Release request or a response to L2 is blocked
Counts ReleaseData requests to L2 to writeback dirty data
Counts Release requests to L2 to relinquish permissions of a block
Counts ProbeAckData responses to L2 which include dirty data
Counts ProbeAck responses to L2 which do not writeback dirty data
Counts ProbeAck responses to L2 indicating a miss in the L1 Data Cache
Counts cycles in which there is at least one entry in the Probe Release Queue
Counts Corrupt responses from L2 indicating corrupted data
Counts Denied responses from L2 indicating an inability to service a request
